metadata.case_name: LAU CHU WING v. LAW WAI SHING AND OTHERS

plaintiff.occupation_before: Security guard / traffic controller supervisor at Underwriter Security
plaintiff.occupation_after: Security guard with Group 4 Falck (HK) Ltd

injuries.description: simple musculo-tendinous strain to his neck and back
source: that Mr Lau is suffering from simple musculo-tendinous strain to his neck and back because of the accident.
injuries.icd_description: Strain or sprain of muscle, fascia or tendon at neck level

manifestations.description: Mild neck and back pain, which occasionally affects his daily activities such as (a) hair washing activity, in that he needs to take rests after bending forward from a stooping position in washing his hair, and (b) prolonged sitting. The pain however could be relived by simple analgesics.
Occasional mild dizziness with apparently no organic neurological origin, which could be relieved by simple medications.
Occasional mild limitation in performing daily activities (hair washing and prolonged sitting) due to neck and back pain.

treatments_received: A&E assessment at Princess Margaret Hospital

losses.description: Residual neck and back pain and stiffness occasionally affecting daily activities (e.g. hair washing, prolonged sitting).
